description: Replaces the absolute task-worktree path recorded in completion handoffs with a machine-independent value relative to the worktree root. Handoffs already written with an absolute path are not rewritten; the CLI still accepts them.
delta: Completion handoffs record the `handoff_worktree` value returned by `meridian worktree prepare` (the path relative to the worktree root) instead of an absolute path, and the reviewer resolves it against the worktree root before locating the entry in `git worktree list --porcelain`. Runtime uses of the absolute path are unchanged, and the absolute common Git directory used for the integration lease is computed at runtime and never written to a tracked file. Existing consumer handoffs that contain an absolute path are not rewritten; `meridian worktree check` accepts both forms.
verification: upgrade from the previous capability versions installs the new blocks while preserving consumer-owned text
worktree check accepts the root-relative and the legacy absolute handoff value and reports handoff-mismatch for any other value
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v pass
